purpose: Separate immediate mechanical rescue from true repair-state EXIT and from durable rewriting of future response under withdrawal or rechallenge.

mechanical_exit_coupling_gate.E1_ESTABLISHED_ACTIVATED_REPAIR_STATE: Before retuning, the same root directly identifies an activated repair/fibrotic cell-state population or a state-specific endogenous repair compartment. Generic collagen amount alone is insufficient for cell-state EXIT.
mechanical_exit_coupling_gate.E2_DIRECT_MECHANICAL_RETUNING: A direct physical/mechanical variable is changed after establishment.
mechanical_exit_coupling_gate.E3_TIME_RESOLVED_STATE_TRANSITION: The same root follows the activated state after retuning with enough temporal resolution to distinguish persistence from transition.
mechanical_exit_coupling_gate.E4_EXIT_MODE_RESOLVED: The root distinguishes apoptosis/clearance, deactivation/redifferentiation, replacement, or another explicit exit route. Marker loss alone without identity control remains UNKNOWN.
mechanical_exit_coupling_gate.E5_MECHANICAL_TO_EXIT_CAUSAL_BINDING: The state transition is bound to the mechanical intervention within the same causal root with contemporaneous controls.
mechanical_exit_coupling_gate.decision: MECHANICAL_EXIT_COUPLED only if E1-E5 are YES; any NO/UNKNOWN => NOT_COUPLED_OR_UNKNOWN

hysteresis_stratification.H1_TRANSIENT_RESCUE_WITH_RECURRENCE: Qualifying rescue occurs, followed by return toward the pathological state after a one-time intervention, withdrawal, or continued follow-up without renewed rescue.
hysteresis_stratification.H2_OFF_INTERVENTION_PERSISTENCE: Improved state persists after the retuning stimulus is removed for a defined washout/follow-up interval, but no adverse rechallenge is performed.
hysteresis_stratification.H3_CHALLENGE_RESISTANT_REWRITE: After withdrawal/washout, the system is re-exposed to a frozen adverse mechanical challenge and retains materially improved state/fate relative to naive/pathological controls.
hysteresis_stratification.H4_UNKNOWN_NO_WITHDRAWAL_OR_RECHALLENGE: The intervention remains mechanically active or the experiment ends before a withdrawal/rechallenge test can distinguish state rewrite from support dependence.

future_set_rule.formal_intuition: A rewrite is supported when the post-retuning state preserves a different response distribution under a renewed challenge, not merely when the present observable is improved.
